Up to 10 spells and 2 upgrades for each can be purchased with SP
Any number of equipments can be crafted using the components you find

Spells and Equipment are only affected by bonuses to attributes in their tooltips
Attribute bonuses come in the form of percent-based and flat bonuses, and are applied in that order

Spells and Equipment can be filtered using the provided filters and with the search function
Filters can be activated by clicking or SHIFT clicking the filter, or by using their hotkeys
You can begin searches with \ to search for exact phrasing, i.e. \ adds the fire tag

Selecting equipment you cannot craft marks it as desired and adds it to your character panel
Left Click a desired item or use SHIFT 1 - 3 to craft it if possible or remove it otherwise

When something says it casts a spell or gains a spell, it will use your version of that spell
Even if you don't own the spell in question, any relevant bonuses you have will be applied

Extra tooltips while examining Rifts and Components contain a Prospective Equipment page
Prospective Equipment cannot be crafted at that moment, but could if you had the component(s) in question

Each level, you can reroll rifts once, closing the existing rifts and opening new ones

Mastery is the sum total SP cost of spells you own with a given tag, including applied upgrades
Hover over a tag filter in the Spell or Equipment shop to see your current mastery for that tag
